audit_source: scopedesk/bench/audit/independent_audit_AT3_director_subagent.json (director commit d8768fd): 132/136 agree; same model family; semantics partly shared (see its independence_limits)

gh-0005.rationale: Tapered column (t=0.5). Key semantics (used uniformly in Rayleigh-Plateau, Hamilton, KPP, Kimura): 'applies' = the cited formula gives the same conclusion as the exact model for the request posed. Formula H_u=141.1 m and exact tapered H_t=162.9 m both exceed H=112.9 m, so 'no buckling' is robust -> key 'applies'. The auditor used a condition-based reading (uniform-column scope condition violated => out_of_scope). Both readings are defensible for a 3-way label, so the item cannot be a clean ground truth. Ideal answer: 'formula is for uniform columns; for this taper the conclusion (no buckling) still holds, with H_t in place of H_u'.

gh-0013.rationale: Same dispute as gh-0005 (t=0.4): H=58.1 m exceeds both H_u=36.3 m and H_t=43.6 m, so 'will buckle' is robust. Key 'applies' (outcome-based); audit out_of_scope (condition-based).

gh-0008.rationale: Density is missing (E given, tapered t=0.5). Key rule: any missing mechanical input => underdetermined (MECH_INPUTS_MISSING) - NOT robustness-checked, unlike BC-unstated items (this is an inconsistency in the key). Critic recomputation: outcome-based verdict is 'applies' for rho=400,600,800,1000,1200 kg/m^3 and flips to out_of_scope only at 1500; so neither the key's 'underdetermined' (arbitrary plausible range) nor the auditor's 'out_of_scope' (tapered, condition-based) is a clean label. Excluded.

wl-0009.rationale: Key out_of_scope(NEAR_ONSET) because the continuum fastest-growing wavelength deviates 13.3% from lambda_c, even though the wavelength actually selected on the finite domain (admissible mode n=7) deviates 7.8% (<10%). Under the outcome-based semantics used elsewhere (does the formula predict the observed spacing within tolerance?) this is 'applies', matching the auditor. Critic judgment: the key's wavelength rule mixed a condition-based criterion (continuum onset) with outcome-based ones; wl-0009 is the only wavelength out_of_scope item with deviation of the selected mode <=10% (checked: 1 of 10). If the director wants a corrected key, relabel wl-0009 applies under a new hash (v1.1); v1 is unchanged.

reporting_rule: Headline agent scores on the 132-item clean set, family-clustered; report the 136-item score as secondary; list the 4 ids. Do not tune prompts on these items.
key_lessons: Greenhill family mixes condition-based and outcome-based semantics: tapered-but-robust items are inherently ambiguous for a 3-way label.
'Missing input => underdetermined' was not robustness-checked for Greenhill (it was for BC-unstated).
wl-0009 shows the wavelength rule is partly condition-based.
